verdict.rationale: Baseten documents deploying open-source, fine-tuned, or custom models on dedicated GPUs. This is separate from its shared per-token Model APIs. Hardware is specified in config.yaml and deployed via truss push or baseten model push. The autoscaling half of the story is not evidenced: the only related claim is MCM rerouting and reprovisioning workloads on capacity loss, which is failover, not traffic-based scaling. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling (replica min/max, scale-to-zero, concurrency targets), explicit statement of traffic isolation from the shared pool, independent or hands-on corroboration.
